verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer can take delegated multi-step work and run it on its own, including launching a cloud browser, filling forms and running code in a sandbox, then return structured results. That is autonomous task execution, but nothing shows a user setting up recurring or triggered automations that keep running in the background. A hands-on report that Computer sessions often fail to trigger or stall further lowers confidence in its autonomous runs. Missing for 10: scheduled/recurring automations, event triggers, background task management or monitoring, independent evidence of reliable autonomous runs.
